items.title: `modfile
items.body: `modfile.Parse` accepts a file with `go 1.27.1` but no `module` directive. `ReadPinImpact` checks the Go directive but never checks `parsed.Module`, so `pin-impact` can report that malformed candidate as unaffected and exit 0 when it is also used as the baseline. The task requires invalid input to exit 2.
items.suggestion: Reject a parsed file without a module directive as `InvalidPinImpactInput`, and cover the CLI exit status with a test.
